subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 28, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - August 28, 2026**

**Kernel Update: Eight Stable Kernels Released**

This week, Greg Kroah-Hartman announced the release of eight stable kernels for Thursday, including 7.2.1 and 7.3.1. These updates bring various bug fixes and improvements to the kernel, ensuring a more stable and secure experience for AcreetionOS users. Our team has already integrated these updates into our latest builds, so you can expect a seamless upgrade experience.

**Community News**

The AcreetionOS community has been buzzing with activity, with several new contributors joining our Discord server and participating in discussions on our forums. We're thrilled to see the growth and enthusiasm for our project. If you're interested in getting involved, join us on Discord and introduce yourself!

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that AcreetionOS has a built-in package manager that allows you to easily install and manage software on your system? To use it, simply open a terminal and type `sudo pacman -S <package_name>`, replacing `<package_name>` with the name of the package you want to install. This is a great way to keep your system up-to-date and discover new software without having to manually search for it.

That's all for this week's newsletter. As always, thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're committed to providing a secure, private, and user-friendly Linux distribution that meets the needs of our users.
